title: Why did Nvidia pop after earnings?
cold_open: Your 401k probably moved today — and one chip name is why.

slides.headline: What happened
slides.narration: Nvidia just reported quarterly results. Revenue beat expectations, but the market still had questions about what comes next.
slides.image_prompt: simple bar chart comparing expected vs actual revenue, chip icons, upward arrow

slides.headline: Why it matters
slides.narration: Think of Nvidia like the shovel seller in a gold rush. When everyone races to build AI, demand for its chips stays hot — but investors still argue about how long the rush lasts.

slides.narration: The real test is guidance and margins, not just one headline number. If you follow this space, save this breakdown — what surprised you most about the reaction?
